Exact biomarker facts (FGFR2, IDH1, HER2, BRAF, NTRK, RET, KRAS G12C, NRG1, MSI/dMMR/TMB) drive option applicability; this summary is not guideline authority.
BIL-C requires regimen selection in clinical context; no single binary performance-status threshold is specified for all listed regimens, so the generic boolean is not used to invent exclusions.
